name: London Fix (11am ET) Impact on EURUSD
description: Studies the London 4pm GMT (11am ET) FX fix impact on EURUSD using 1-minute bars. Defines a pre-fix window (10:45-11:00 ET) and post-fix window (11:00-11:15 ET). Computes the directional move into the fix and the post-fix reaction in pips. Classifies each day as reversal (post-fix opposes pre-fix direction) or continuation. Outputs a summary table with avg absolute moves, reversal/continuation rates, conditioned stats by pre-fix direction, and a scatter plot of pre-fix vs post-fix move with regression line to visualize systematic fading.
source:
# =============================================================================
# LONDON FIX (11am ET / 4pm GMT) — EURUSD
# =============================================================================
# Pre-fix window:  10:45–11:00 ET (directional move INTO the fix)
# Post-fix window: 11:00–11:15 ET (reaction AFTER the fix)
# Move unit: pips (1 pip = 0.0001 for EURUSD, so multiply by 10000)
#
# Classification:
#   Reversal = post-fix direction opposes pre-fix direction
#   Continuation = post-fix direction matches pre-fix direction
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE (1-minute bars) ===
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1Min)()

# === SESSION WINDOWS ===
pre_fix = session_window(session=Session(start='10:45', end='11:00', tz='America/New_York'))(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)
post_fix = session_window(session=Session(start='11:00', end='11:15', tz='America/New_York'))(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)

# === CAPTURE PRE-FIX MOVE AT PRE-FIX CLOSE, CARRY WITHIN DAY ===
# Pre-fix move = pre-fix session close minus session open (in pips)
pre_move_snapshot = where(pre_fix.closed, (pre_fix.close - pre_fix.open) * 10000)
pre_move_filled = ffill_day(pre_move_snapshot)

# === CAPTURE POST-FIX MOVE AT POST-FIX CLOSE ===
# Post-fix open = fix price at 11:00 ET exactly
# Post-fix move = post-fix session close minus fix price (in pips)
post_move_snapshot = where(post_fix.closed, (post_fix.close - post_fix.open) * 10000)

# === ONE OBSERVATION PER DAY (at post-fix close = 11:15 ET) ===
is_event = post_fix.closed
pre_pips = where(is_event, pre_move_filled)
post_pips = post_move_snapshot

# === ABSOLUTE MOVES ===
abs_pre_pips = abs(pre_pips)
abs_post_pips = abs(post_pips)

# === DIRECTION FLAGS ===
is_bull_pre = pre_pips > 0
is_bear_pre = pre_pips < 0
has_direction = is_bull_pre or is_bear_pre

# === REVERSAL / CONTINUATION CLASSIFICATION ===
# Reversal: post-fix opposes pre-fix (bull pre + bear post, or bear pre + bull post)
# Continuation: post-fix matches pre-fix direction
is_rev = (pre_pips > 0 and post_pips < 0) or (pre_pips < 0 and post_pips > 0)
is_cont = (pre_pips > 0 and post_pips > 0) or (pre_pips < 0 and post_pips < 0)

# Flag series (only for days with non-zero pre-fix move)
rev_flag = where(has_direction, 1.0 if is_rev else 0.0)
cont_flag = where(has_direction, 1.0 if is_cont else 0.0)

# === CONDITIONED METRICS ===
# Average post-fix move by pre-fix direction
bull_post_move = where(is_bull_pre, post_pips)
bear_post_move = where(is_bear_pre, post_pips)

# Reversal rate by pre-fix direction
bull_rev_flag = where(is_bull_pre, 1.0 if (post_pips < 0) else 0.0)
bear_rev_flag = where(is_bear_pre, 1.0 if (post_pips > 0) else 0.0)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# --- Summary Table: Pre- vs Post-Fix Move Statistics ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='London Fix (11am ET): Pre- vs Post-Fix Statistics',
        row_size=9,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=[
            'Avg Abs Pre-Fix Move (pips)',
            'Avg Abs Post-Fix Move (pips)',
            'Overall Reversal Rate',
            'Overall Continuation Rate',
            'Bullish Pre-Fix: Avg Post-Fix Move (pips)',
            'Bearish Pre-Fix: Avg Post-Fix Move (pips)',
            'Bullish Pre-Fix: Reversal Rate',
            'Bearish Pre-Fix: Reversal Rate',
            'Day Count'
        ],
        col_headers=['Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=6, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=7, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=8, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='Fix Analysis',
    order=0
)(abs_pre_pips, abs_post_pips, rev_flag, cont_flag, bull_post_move, bear_post_move, bull_rev_flag, bear_rev_flag, pre_pips)

# --- Scatter: Pre-Fix Move vs Post-Fix Move ---
xy_scatter(
    title='Pre-Fix Move vs Post-Fix Move — London Fix (11am ET)',
    category='Fix Analysis',
    x_axis_label='Pre-Fix Move (pips, + = bullish)',
    y_axis_label='Post-Fix Move (pips, + = bullish)',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    show_trend_line=True,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Daily Fix Events', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x=pre_pips, y_values=post_pips)

# --- Event Markers for individual fix days ---
ev_pre = where(is_event, pre_move_filled)
ev_post = post_pips
ev_rev_label = where(is_event, 1.0 if is_rev else (0.0 if is_cont else 0.0 / 0.0))

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='London Fix Events',
        icon=Icon.ClockIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Pre-Fix Move (pips)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle, title='Post-Fix Move (pips)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Footer, title='Reversal (1=Yes, 0=No)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0)
        ]
    )
)(is_event, ev_pre, ev_post, ev_rev_label)
